newsitem.title: USA: Nuevo Energy to redeem 12-1/2 pct notes.
newsitem.headline: Nuevo Energy to redeem 12-1/2 pct notes.

text.p: Nuevo Energy Co said Friday it will redeem on June 15 its 12-1/2 percent senior subordinated notes due 2002.

The redemption price is $1,040 plus accrued interest of $62.50 per $1,000 principal amount of the notes. In aggregate, the company will pay $78 million, including the accrued interest and $3 million in premium.
Nuevo will finance the redemption through its revolving credit agreement.

Annual interest expense savings are expected to be over $4.5 million, Nuevo said. The additional cash flow will add to profitability and be reinvested in exploitation and exploration projects, it said.
Nuevo is a Houston-based company primarily engaged in the exploration for, and the acquisition, exploitation, development and production of, crude oil and natural gas.
